message.content:
The cover of the magazine "TEMPO" is featured. The publication's title is displayed in large, silver-colored, serif capital letters at the top. Below this, in smaller black text, it reads "EDISI KHUSUS | 16-22 NOVEMBER 2015".

The main headline, "CERITA DARI LAUT," is printed in large, black, sans-serif capital letters. Below it, a block of black text states: "Tak melulu soal keindahan, inilah kisah mengenai kearifan lokal menjaga alam. Reportase sembilan pantai di pelosok Nusantara."

The central illustration is an open, old-fashioned book with thick, layered pages. The book’s cover is dark and weathered. Emerging from its center is a pop-up paper scene depicting stylized ocean waves, a small paper boat, and several palm trees. All these elements appear to be made of thin, light-colored paper with textured patterns. The boat is folded in a traditional origami style, while the trees have finely cut fronds.

In the bottom left corner, there is a barcode. Beside it, the price "RP 39.500" and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO" are visible along with "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273".
